summary: The MaintServiceProfile is a component of the HSPnet application that manages service profiles, including their setup and display within a web interface. It involves several UI elements that allow users to view and potentially edit service information.
purpose: The component is designed to load, display, and manage information related to service profiles, including details about positions, history, and main service data.

workflows.name: Display Profile
steps: Set visibility based on tab and conditions

business_rules: ServiceID should be validated and converted from query string
validations: Check if effective date is provided when pay scales are selected
Validate the relationship between default and secondary pay scales
conditions: if ReadOnly is true, the page is not editable
if SiteUsesPositions is false, disable the Positions tab
system_behavior: LoadServiceInfo method manages retrieval and setting up of service data
SetupHeader method configures UI elements with service data
dependencies: ProfileExists flag impacts UI header display
Editable screens depend on user role and permissions
